
# picrust2 预测

解析功能预测结果，并基于两种细菌通路差异，探讨假单胞菌在低细胞数条件下占主导地位的现象。


## 加载必要的包

```{r}
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(tidyverse)
library(dunn.test)
library(multcompView)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(rstatix)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)
library(circlize)  
library(ComplexHeatmap)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

## 增加的初始细胞数增强群落功能

### 通路差异分析方法

对预测的通路进行差异分析，通过对每列进行归一化处理来显示差异。以不同碳源为例展示相同碳源下不同细胞数的通路差异。

```{r}
# Read data
kegg_data <- read_delim("./data/keggrest/annotated_kegg_abundance_cleanL2.tsv", delim = "\t")
metadata <- read_csv("./data/sample_metadata.csv", col_types = "ccccddc")

# ========== 2. 相对丰度转换 ==========
# Note: The tsv is already in percentages, but if needed, confirm colSums ~100
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(kegg_data), c("L2", "L1"))
# If not already relative, uncomment below:
# kegg_relative <- kegg_data
# kegg_relative[sample_cols] <- sweep(kegg_data[sample_cols], 2, colSums(kegg_data[sample_cols], na.rm=TRUE), FUN = "/") * 100
kegg_relative <- kegg_data # Assuming already relative
# ========== 3. 转成长表，并合并 metadata ==========
kegg_long <- kegg_relative %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression")
merged_data <- inner_join(kegg_long, metadata, by = c("sample" = "sampleID")) %>%
  mutate(cell_num = as.character(cell_num)) %>%
  distinct()
# ========== 7. 准备绘图数据 ==========
# 先按 L1 和 L2 排序所有数据，确保全局一致顺序
sorted_paths <- merged_data %>%
  select(L1, L2) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(L1, L2) # 按 L1 分组排序 L2
data_for_plot <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    L2 = factor(L2, levels = unique(sorted_paths$L2)), # 使用全局排序
    cell_num_factor = factor(cell_num, levels = c("10", "50", "100", "250")),
    L1 = gsub(" ", "\n", L1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### 气泡图可视化通路的差异

```{r}
stat_res <- data_for_plot %>%
  group_by(carbon, L2) %>%
  rstatix::kruskal_test(expression ~ cell_num) %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%  # 筛选显著通路
  arrange(carbon, padj)


# 1. 筛选并聚合数据
bubble_data <- data_for_plot %>%
  filter(L2 %in% unique(stat_res$L2)) %>%
  group_by(carbon, L2, cell_num) %>%
  summarise(mean_abd = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # 计算 Z-score
  group_by(carbon, L2) %>%
  mutate(z_score = scale(mean_abd)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ========== 2. 【核心修复】指定 X 轴顺序 ==========
bubble_data$cell_num <- factor(as.character(bubble_data$cell_num), 
                               levels = c("10", "50", "100", "250"))


# 如果显著通路太多，建议取前20-30个，否则Y轴会挤在一起
# top_pathways <- stat_res %>% group_by(carbon) %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% pull(L2)
# bubble_data <- bubble_data %>% filter(L2 %in% top_pathways)


# 1. 筛选并聚合数据
bubble_data <- data_for_plot %>%
  filter(L2 %in% unique(stat_res$L2)) %>%
  group_by(carbon, L2, cell_num) %>%
  summarise(mean_abd = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # 计算 Z-score
  group_by(carbon, L2) %>%
  mutate(z_score = scale(mean_abd)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ========== 2. 【核心修复】指定 X 轴顺序 ==========
bubble_data$cell_num <- factor(as.character(bubble_data$cell_num), 
                               levels = c("10", "50", "100", "250"))



p <- ggplot(bubble_data, aes(x = cell_num, y = L2)) +
  # --- 气泡层 ---
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_abd, color = z_score)) +
  
  # --- 颜色梯度 ---
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "firebrick", midpoint = 0) +
  
  # --- 气泡大小 ---
  scale_size(range = c(1, 4), name = "Abundance (%)") + # 稍微调大了范围，看得更清楚
  
  # --- 分面 ---
  facet_grid(~ carbon, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  
  # --- 主题 ---
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Cell Number",
    y = "Significantly Enriched Pathways (L2)",
    color = "Z-score (Relative)",
    title = "Metabolic Pathway Enrichment"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  )

p

#graph2pdf(p, file = "picrust2.pdf", width = 8, height =10 )
```
### 热图可视化通路的差异

```{r}
# Custom colors for L1 (expanded to all categories in data)
custom_l1_colors <- c(
  "Cellular Processes" = "#984EA3", # purple
  "Environmental Information Processing" = "#4DAF4A", # green
  "Genetic Information Processing" = "#377EB8", # blue
  "Human Diseases" = "#E31A1C", # red
  "Metabolism" = "#FF7F00", # orange
  "Organismal Systems" = "#33A02C" # dark green
)
# ========== 8. 画图 ==========
unique_carbons <- unique(data_for_plot$carbon)
plot_list <- list() # 收集热图
for (carb in unique_carbons) {
  data_sub <- data_for_plot %>%
    filter(carbon == carb) %>%
    mutate(L2 = droplevels(L2)) # Drop unused levels
  # 计算均值
  summary_data <- data_sub %>%
    group_by(L1, L2, cell_num_factor) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  # 准备热图矩阵：行是L2，列是cell_num_factor，值是mean_expr，按 L1, L2 排序
  heat_matrix <- summary_data %>%
    arrange(L1, L2) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cell_num_factor, values_from = mean_expr) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "L2") %>%
    select(-L1) %>%
    as.matrix()
  # Per-row normalization to 0-1 for better distinction within each pathway
  heat_matrix_norm <- t(apply(heat_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (diff(rng) == 0) {
      rep(0.5, length(x)) # uniform if no variation
    } else {
      (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
    }
  }))
  # 获取 row_split：按排序后的 L1
  row_l1 <- summary_data %>%
    arrange(L1, L2) %>%
    distinct(L1, L2) %>%
    pull(L1)
  # 定义注解颜色
  unique_l1 <- unique(row_l1)
  original_l1 <- gsub("\n", " ", unique_l1)
  l1_colors <- setNames(custom_l1_colors[original_l1], unique_l1)
  # 如果有未定义的颜色，可以设置为默认
  l1_colors[is.na(l1_colors)] <- "grey"
  # 行注解
  row_anno <- rowAnnotation(L1 = row_l1, col = list(L1 = l1_colors),annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                          annotation_name_rot = 0)
  # 颜色映射（修改为8格颜色）
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(0, 1, length.out = 8), rev(brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "RdYlBu")))
  # 绘制热图（去除 column_split 和 top_anno，关闭列聚类以保证顺序，并恢复x轴顺序为10,50,100,250）
  ht <- Heatmap(heat_matrix_norm,
                name = "Norm Abund",
                col = col_fun,
                row_split = row_l1, # 根据 L1 分割
                cluster_rows = TRUE, # 在每个分割内聚类
                cluster_columns = F, # 关闭列聚类以保证顺序
                column_order = c("10", "50", "100", "250"), # 恢复x轴顺序
                rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5), # 显示方格边框
                show_column_names = TRUE, # 显示每列的横坐标（列名）
                row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
                clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                clustering_method_columns = "average" ,
                column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                column_names_centered = TRUE,  # x轴标签居中对齐
                row_title = NULL, # 关闭行标题显示（L1名称）
                row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                right_annotation = row_anno,
                show_parent_dend_line = FALSE, # 去除所有聚类树的虚线
                heatmap_legend_param = list(
                  title = "Row-normalized\nrelative abundance",
                  at = seq(0, 1, length.out = 8), # 修改为8格
                  labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0, 1, length.out = 8))
                ),
                column_names_rot = 0,  # x轴标签正置
                width = unit(4, "cm"),  # 缩小瓦片宽度
                column_title = paste("KEGG Pathways for", carb, "")
  )
  print(ht)
  #export::graph2ppt(x = ht, file = "picrust2.pptx", append = TRUE)
 
  # 绘制并收集（使用 grid.grabExpr 以捕获 gtable-like 对象）
  plot_list[[carb]] <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(ht))
  # ========== 9. 打印该碳源下二级通路所属一级通路的表格 ==========
  pathway_table <- data_sub %>%
    select(L2, L1) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(L2)
  cat(paste("\nPathway table for", carb, ":\n"))
  print(pathway_table)
}
```
